description: Implementation of the egl::Display interface for macOS using CGL, including context creation, surface management, and extension generation.

classes.name: FunctionsGLCGL
classes.description: Handles loading OpenGL functions dynamically from a dylib handle.

classes.name: DisplayCGL
classes.description: Implements egl::Display for macOS using CGL, managing contexts, surfaces, and extensions.

classes.name: WorkerContextCGL
classes.description: Represents a worker OpenGL context for CGL, managing context current state.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the display, creates pixel format and context, and loads OpenGL functions.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources, destroys pixel format and context.

methods.name: createWindowSurface
methods.description: Creates a window surface for rendering.

methods.name: createPbufferFromClientBuffer
methods.description: Creates a surface from a client buffer, specifically IOSurface.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates an OpenGL context, possibly with discrete GPU preference.

methods.name: isValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Checks if a native window is a valid CALayer.

methods.name: getCGLPixelFormat
methods.description: Returns the current CGL pixel format.

methods.name: makeCurrentSurfaceless
methods.description: Makes context current without a surface.
